cooldown.binNote: Matches the ddragon summary and the 'Volley' bin object's own cooldown row. One of four vestigial duplicate spell objects for this ability, VolleyRank2, instead carries [18/14.5/11/6.5/4] (6.5 not 7.5 at rank 4); VolleyRank3-5 agree with 'Volley' at 7.5. Reported here since it is the kind of internal-bin discrepancy worth recording, even though ddragon and the wiki both independently support 7.5.

values.binNote: Matches the primary 'Volley' bin object exactly (BaseDamage [60/95/130/165/200], ADRatio 1 on bonus ad). Four other same-slot bin objects (VolleyRank2, VolleyRank3, VolleyRank4, VolleyRank5) instead carry BaseDamage [20/35/50/65/80] scaling off 1x total ad (not bonus ad) - a much lower, differently-scaled progression the wiki does not corroborate anywhere. Treated as stale duplicates here because the wiki's leveling table matches 'Volley' precisely and ddragon's cooldown line also matches 'Volley'/Rank3-5 rather than Rank2, but this is a large enough discrepancy (fully different formula, not just one differing number) that it is also raised in top.json's unsettled list.

mechanics.claim: A single enemy can be crossed by more than one of the cone's arrows but only ever takes damage from the first arrow that hits it - Volley cannot deal its damage more than once to the same target.
mechanics.quote: Enemies can intercept multiple arrows but do not take damage from any beyond the first.

mechanics.claim: Volley's damage resolves at the end of its cast time, not at the moment of cast.
